SiteContent.title: SiteContent
SiteContent.description: Editable copy, profile handles, stats, love letter, music link, and theme configuration for The Princess Kingdom.

displayName.description: Primary display name shown across the kingdom site.

accountSubtitle.description: Subtitle under the account name in navigation and hero pill.

instagramHandle.description: Instagram username without leading @ or with @.

bioTitle.description: Heading for the hero bio section.

bioText.description: Narrative bio paragraph on the hero card.

friendsLabel.description: Friends count label in the stats card.

hugButtonText.description: Label for the hug action button.

shareButtonText.description: Label for the share love action button.

tiktokHugs.description: Hugs stat value on social card.

tiktokSmiles.description: Smiles stat value on social card.

tiktokLikes.description: Likes stat value on social card.

pinnedSubtitle.description: Subtitle on the pinned showcase card.

pinnedCaption.description: Bottom caption on the pinned showcase card.

letterTitle.description: Heading of the love letter section.

letterBody.description: Full text body of the love letter.

finaleTitle.description: Closing headline above the love button.

finaleButtonText.description: Text inside the finale celebration button.

songUrl.description: External URL for the couple's song.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when content was last updated.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who made the last update.

PhotoItem.title: PhotoItem
PhotoItem.description: A single gallery photo or video slot stored as a compressed image data URL, inline video data URL, chunked video metadata, or external HTTPS URL.

slotKey.description: Target slot identifier (s0-s13) or extra gallery identifier.

sectionLabel.description: Human-readable name of the slot or gallery item.

imageData.description: Compressed base64 image/poster data URI or HTTPS URL.

caption.description: Optional photo or video caption or alt description.

isExtra.description: True for admin-added extra gallery items beyond the 14 base slots.

status.description: Visibility status of the media item.

mediaType.description: Media kind ('image' or 'video'). Defaults to 'image' when omitted.

videoData.description: Optional inline video data URI (for compact clips) or HTTPS video URL.

chunkCount.description: Number of ordered chunks stored under /photos/{photoId}/chunks for larger uploaded videos.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded media item (e.g. video/mp4).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the media item was uploaded or modified.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who uploaded or modified the media item.

MediaChunk.title: MediaChunk
MediaChunk.description: An ordered base64 slice of a larger uploaded gallery video stored under a parent PhotoItem.

data.description: Base64 substring slice of the video data URL.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was uploaded.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who uploaded the chunk.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

createdByUid.description: UID of the super admin who granted access.

/site_content/{docId}.description: Stores the editable website text, handles, stats, love letter, and theme preferences.

/photos/{photoId}.description: Stores each photo/video slot (s0-s13) and admin-added extra gallery photos and videos.

/photos/{photoId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Stores ordered video data chunks for larger gallery videos.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Allowlist of authorized admin UIDs managed by the primary owner.
